steps.claim: The factory maps a string kind to a registered class and raises rather than guessing when the kind is unknown.
The settlement date is rolled forward to the next business day, with a hard ceiling that raises instead of looping forever.
The engine discounts off the currency curve, then branches: options go through Black-76 with a surface lookup, everything else is a forward difference.
Serialization rounds the present value to six decimals and the discount factor to eight before it leaves the process.

claims.text: The house style favours raising a named exception over returning None.
Modules are kept import-acyclic; nothing in io imports upward.
New instrument types are expected to register themselves rather than be dispatched on.
